items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ... І҆орда́не рѣко̀ что̀ оу҆диви́лся є҆сѝ, зря̀ неви́димаго на́га? ви́дѣхъ и҆ вострепета́хъ, речѐ, и҆ ка́кѡ бо сегѡ̀ не хотѣ́хъ оу҆страши́тися и҆ зайтѝ? а҆́гг҃ли є҆гѡ̀ оу҆страши́шася зря́ще; оу҆жасе́ся не́бо, и҆ земля̀ вострепета̀
items.english_text: Wrapped in the streams of the Jordan, Thou Who art most gloriously clothed with light as with a garment, in them Thou hast renewed Adam's nature, crushed by evil disobedience, O Word of God. Therefore we praise Thee, and all of us glorify Thy holy Epiphany.[^924]

provenance.verbatim_source: Wrapped in the streams of the Jordan, Thou Who art most gloriously clothed with light as with a garment, in them Thou hast renewed Adam's nature, crushed by evil disobedience, O Word of God. Therefore we praise Thee, and all of us glorify Thy holy Epiphany.[^924]

items.english_text: O river Jordan, why wast thou amazed, beholding the Invisible One naked? I saw and trembled, it said; and how should I not have been afraid of Him and retreated? His angels were terrified as they beheld Him; heaven was dismayed, and earth trembled—[^925]

items.slavonic_text: смѧте́ся мо́ре, и҆ вся̑ ви̑димаѧ и҆ неви̑димаѧ; Хрⷭ҇то́съ ꙗ҆ви́ся на І҆орда́нѣ ѡ҆свѧти́ти во́ды.
items.english_text: —the sea was troubled, and all things visible and invisible. Christ has appeared at the Jordan to sanctify the waters.[^926]

items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.:
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Бж҃е оу҆ще́дри ны̀, и҆ бл҃гословѝ ны̀, просвѣтѝ лицѐ твоѐ на ны̀, и҆ поми́лꙋй ны̀. И҆ возгремѣ̀ съ небесѐ Гдⷭ҇ь, и҆ Вы́шнїй дадѐ гла́съ сво́й. Воздвиго́ша рѣ́ки Гдⷭ҇и, воздвиго́ша рѣ́ки гла́сы своя̑. Сегѡ̀ ра́ди помѧнꙋ́хъ ѿ землѝ І҆орда́нски и҆ Є҆рмоні́имски. Мо́ре ви́дѣ и҆ побѣжѐ, І҆орда́нъ возврати́ся вспя́ть. Ви́дѣша тѧ̀ во́ды Бж҃е, ви́дѣша тѧ̀ во́ды и҆ оу҆боя́шася. Въ мо́ри пꙋтїѐ твоѝ, и҆ стєзѝ твоѝ во вода́хъ мно́гихъ. Ꙗ҆́ко возвели́чишася дѣла̀ твоя̀ Го́споди, и҆ вся̑ премꙋ́дростїю сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ. Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: А҆ллилꙋ́їа, г҃. Креща́ется І҆исъ мо́й ѿ раба̀, во І҆орда́нстѣй рѣцѣ̀: просвѣща́яй всю̀ тва́рь.
items.english_text: We magnify Thee, O Christ Giver of life, Who for our sake wast baptized in the flesh by John in the waters of the Jordan.[^928]

provenance.verbatim_source: We magnify Thee, O Christ Giver of life, Who for our sake wast baptized in the flesh by John in the waters of the Jordan.[^928]

items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ... Прїиди́те оу҆ви́димъ вѣ́рнїи, гдѣ̀ кр҃ти́ся Хрⷭ҇то́съ? да послѣ́дꙋемъ про́чее ко І҆орда́нꙋ рѣцѣ̀, къ гла́сꙋ вопїю́щагѡ въ пꙋсты́ни; и҆ оу҆ви́димъ та́мѡ содѣ́теля А҆да́мова, дла́нїю ра́бскою рꙋкополага́ема за бл҃гоꙋтро́бїе неизрече́нное, и҆ къ немꙋ̀ велегла́снѡ возопїи́мъ: прише́лъ є҆сѝ и҆ ꙗ҆ви́лся є҆сѝ во І҆орда́нѣ ѡ҆ст҃и́ти во́ды.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4. Podoben: Joseph was amazed...* Come, O faithful, let us behold where Christ was baptized; let us now follow unto the river Jordan, unto the voice of one crying in the wilderness; and let us see there the Creator of Adam, having a servant's hand laid upon Him in His ineffable tender compassion, and let us cry aloud unto Him with a loud voice: Thou hast come and hast appeared in the Jordan to sanctify the waters.[^930]

provenance.verbatim_source:

Come, O faithful, let us behold where Christ was baptized; let us now follow unto the river Jordan, unto the voice of one crying in the wilderness; and let us see there the Creator of Adam, having a servant's hand laid upon Him in His ineffable tender compassion, and let us cry aloud unto Him with a loud voice: Thou hast come and hast appeared in the Jordan to sanctify the waters.[^930]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ канѡ́нъ, Гла́съ в҃. — І҆рмо́съ: Ше́ствꙋетъ морскꙋ́ю волня́щꙋюся бꙋ́рю, сꙋ́шꙋ а҆́бїе І҆и҃ль ꙗ҆́вльшꙋся; че́рмный же по́нтъ трїста́ты є҆гѵ́петскїѧ покры̀ кꙋ́пнѡ, водостла́ненъ гро́бъ, си́лою крѣ́пкою, десни́цы Влⷣчни.
items.english_text: The Lord, mighty in battles, has laid bare the bottom of the deep, and leads His own across dry land, having covered the adversaries therein: for He has been glorified.[^936]

provenance.verbatim_source: The Lord, mighty in battles, has laid bare the bottom of the deep, and leads His own across dry land, having covered the adversaries therein: for He has been glorified.[^936]

items.english_text: By the streams of the Jordan the Lord, the King of ages, renews fallen Adam, and crushes the heads of the dragons nesting therein: for He has been glorified.[^937]

items.english_text: Clothed in material flesh with the immaterial fire of the Godhead, the Lord Who was incarnate of the Virgin is enveloped in the Jordan's water: for He has been glorified.[^938]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ канѡ́нъ, Гла́съ в҃. — І҆рмо́съ: Ше́ствꙋетъ морскꙋ́ю волня́щꙋюся бꙋ́рю, сꙋ́шꙋ а҆́бїе І҆и҃ль ꙗ҆́вльшꙋся; че́рмный же по́нтъ трїста́ты є҆гѵ́петскїѧ покры̀ кꙋ́пнѡ, водостла́ненъ гро́бъ, си́лою крѣ́пкою, десни́цы Влⷣчни.
items.english_text: Washing away the defilement of men, the Lord, Who enlightens those who are in darkness, is cleansed in the Jordan for their sakes, having willed to be made like unto them, while remaining what He was: for He has been glorified.[^939]

provenance.verbatim_source: Washing away the defilement of men, the Lord, Who enlightens those who are in darkness, is cleansed in the Jordan for their sakes, having willed to be made like unto them, while remaining what He was: for He has been glorified.[^939]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ канѡ́нъ, Гла́съ в҃. — І҆рмо́съ: Ше́ствꙋетъ морскꙋ́ю волня́щꙋюся бꙋ́рю, сꙋ́шꙋ а҆́бїе І҆и҃ль ꙗ҆́вльшꙋся; че́рмный же по́нтъ трїста́ты є҆гѵ́петскїѧ покры̀ кꙋ́пнѡ, водостла́ненъ гро́бъ, си́лою крѣ́пкою, десни́цы Влⷣчни.
items.english_text: Israel traverses the surging tempest of the sea, suddenly revealed as dry land; while the Red Sea completely submerged the Egyptian captains, a watery grave, by the mighty strength of the Master's right hand.[^940]

provenance.verbatim_source: Israel traverses the surging tempest of the sea, suddenly revealed as dry land; while the Red Sea completely submerged the Egyptian captains, a watery grave, by the mighty strength of the Master's right hand.[^940]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.section: At the Aposticha, Idiomelon Stichera, Tone 2
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́трꙋ ꙗ҆́вльшꙋся человѣ́кѡмъ свѣтоно́снꙋ, ны́нѣ и҆зъ пꙋсты́ни къ вода́мъ І҆орда́нскимъ цр҃ю̀ приклони́лъ є҆сѝ со́лнца твою̀ вы́ю, ли́ка мра́чна родонача́лника и҆схы́тити, скве́рны же вся́кїя ѡ҆чи́стити тва́рь.
items.english_text: When the light-bearing dawn appeared unto men, coming now from the wilderness unto the streams of the Jordan, O King, Sun [of righteousness], Thou didst bow Thy neck to snatch away the dark prince from his flock, and to cleanse creation from all defilement.[^941]

provenance.verbatim_source: When the light-bearing dawn appeared unto men, coming now from the wilderness unto the streams of the Jordan, O King, Sun [of righteousness], Thou didst bow Thy neck to snatch away the dark prince from his flock, and to cleanse creation from all defilement.[^941]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.section: At the Aposticha, Idiomelon Stichera, Tone 2
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Безнача́льне стрꙋя́мъ спогре́бшася тебѣ̀ Сло́ве, но́ваго приво́диши и҆стлѣ́вшаго ле́стїю: сего̀ несказа́ннѡ ѿ О҆ц҃а̀ прїе́мъ гла́съ держа́венъ: се́й возлю́бленный, ра́венъ же мнѣ̀ ѻ҆́трокъ є҆стество́мъ.
items.english_text: Co-buried with Thee in the streams, O unoriginate Word, Thou bringest him who was corrupted by deception made new again, receiving this mighty voice ineffably from the Father: This is My beloved Child, and equal unto Me in nature.[^942]

provenance.verbatim_source: Co-buried with Thee in the streams, O unoriginate Word, Thou bringest him who was corrupted by deception made new again, receiving this mighty voice ineffably from the Father: This is My beloved Child, and equal unto Me in nature.[^942]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь г҃. — І҆рмо́съ: Крѣ́пость дая́й царє́мъ на́шымъ Гдⷭ҇ь, и҆ ро́гъ пома́занныхъ свои́хъ вознося́й, ѿ Дѣ́вы ражда́ется, грѧде́тъ же ко кр҃ще́нїю; томꙋ̀ вѣ́рнїи возопїе́мъ: нѣ́сть свѧ́тъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ на́шъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* The Lord Who gives strength unto our kings, and exalts the horn of His anointed, is born of the Virgin, and comes unto baptism; unto Him, O faithful, let us cry aloud: There is none holy as our God.[^943]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
The Lord Who gives strength unto our kings, and exalts the horn of His anointed, is born of the Virgin, and comes unto baptism; unto Him, O faithful, let us cry aloud: There is none holy as our God.[^943]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Непло́днаѧ дре́вле и҆ безча́днаѧ лю́тѣ, дне́сь весели́ся Хрїсто́ва цр҃ковь: водо́ю бо и҆ Дх҃омъ сы́нове тебѣ̀ роди́шася, вѣ́рою взыва́юще: нѣ́сть ꙗ҆́коже Бг҃ъ на́шъ.
items.english_text: Rejoice today, O Church of Christ, who aforetime wast barren and grievously childless; for through water and the Spirit sons have been born unto thee, crying aloud in faith: There is none holy as our God.[^944]

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice today, O Church of Christ, who aforetime wast barren and grievously childless; for through water and the Spirit sons have been born unto thee, crying aloud in faith: There is none holy as our God.[^944]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Ве́лїимъ гла́сомъ въ пꙋсты́ни вопїе́тъ Пре́дтеча: Хрїстꙋ̀ оу҆гото́вайте пꙋтѝ, и҆ стєзѝ Бо́гꙋ на́шемꙋ пра́вы содѣ́лайте, вѣ́рою взыва́юще: нѣ́сть ст҃ъ ꙗ҆́коже Бг҃ъ на́шъ.
items.english_text: With a loud voice the Forerunner cries aloud in the wilderness: Prepare the ways of Christ, and make straight the paths for our God, crying aloud in faith: There is none holy as our God.[^945]

provenance.verbatim_source: With a loud voice the Forerunner cries aloud in the wilderness: Prepare the ways of Christ, and make straight the paths for our God, crying aloud in faith: There is none holy as our God.[^945]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ канѡ́нъ — І҆рмо́съ: Є҆ли́цы дре́вныхъ и҆зрѣши́хомся сѣ́тей, бра́шенъ льви́въ сотре́нныхъ чле́новными, ра́дꙋимся и҆ расшири́мъ оу҆ста̀, сло́во плелꙋ́ще ѿ слове́съ сладкопѣ́нїя, и҆́мже къ на́мъ наслажда́ется дарова́нїй.
items.english_text: As many as have been released from the ancient snares of the lions whose teeth are broken, let us rejoice and open wide our mouth, weaving words of sweet singing from words [of praise], whereby He takes delight in the gifts granted unto us.[^946]

provenance.verbatim_source: As many as have been released from the ancient snares of the lions whose teeth are broken, let us rejoice and open wide our mouth, weaving words of sweet singing from words [of praise], whereby He takes delight in the gifts granted unto us.[^946]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нїе пе́рвѣе насади́вый тва́ри, ѕвѣ́ря ѕлодѣ́йственнагѡ вообра́жся въ є҆стество̀, ѻ҆мрача́ется плотски́мъ прише́ствїемъ: оу҆́трꙋ ꙗ҆́вльшꙋся прирази́вся Влⷣцѣ, сокрꙋши́ти свою̀ вражде́бнꙋю главꙋ̀.
items.english_text: He who aforetime planted mortification in creation, having taken on the nature of the malevolent beast, is darkened by [Christ's] bodily coming; having rushed against the Master when the dawn appeared, that he might crush his own hostile head.[^947]

provenance.verbatim_source: He who aforetime planted mortification in creation, having taken on the nature of the malevolent beast, is darkened by [Christ's] bodily coming; having rushed against the Master when the dawn appeared, that he might crush his own hostile head.[^947]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Влече́тъ къ себѣ̀ бг҃озда́нное є҆стество̀, оу҆тро́бы мꙋчи́теля, погребе́нное предѣ́лы: ражда́ется па́ки земноро́дныхъ ѡ҆бновле́нїе, дѣ́ло держа́вно соверша́я Влⷣка: прїи́де бо, то́е ѡ҆чи́стити хотя̀.
items.english_text: The tyrant's belly draws unto itself the nature fashioned by God, buried within its bounds; but the renewal of earthborn men is born anew, the Master mightily accomplishing the work: for He has come, desiring to cleanse it.[^948]

provenance.verbatim_source: The tyrant's belly draws unto itself the nature fashioned by God, buried within its bounds; but the renewal of earthborn men is born anew, the Master mightily accomplishing the work: for He has come, desiring to cleanse it.[^948]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Ѵ҆пакоѝ, Гла́съ є҃. Є҆гда̀ ꙗ҆вле́нїемъ твои́мъ просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ вся́ческая, тогда̀ сла́ное невѣ́рїя мо́ре побѣжѐ: и҆ І҆орда́нъ до́лѣ текїй возврати́ся, къ небесѝ возвыша́я на́съ: но высото́ю Боже́ственныхъ за́повѣдей твои́хъ соблюдѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, мл҃твами Бцⷣи, и҆ поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: *Hypakoe, Tone 5:* When Thou didst enlighten all things by Thine Epiphany, then the salty sea of unbelief fled, and Jordan flowing downward turned back, raising us up unto heaven; but by the height of Thy divine commandments preserve us, O Christ God, through the prayers of the Theotokos, and have mercy on us.[^949]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Hypakoe, Tone 5:*
When Thou didst enlighten all things by Thine Epiphany, then the salty sea of unbelief fled, and Jordan flowing downward turned back, raising us up unto heaven; but by the height of Thy divine commandments preserve us, O Christ God, through the prayers of the Theotokos, and have mercy on us.[^949]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. — І҆рмо́съ. Оу҆слы́шахъ Гдⷭ҇и гла́съ тво́й є҆го́же ре́клъ є҆сѝ, гла́съ вопїю́щагѡ въ пꙋсты́ни, ꙗ҆́кѡ возгремѣ́лъ є҆сѝ на́дъ вода́ми мно́гими, твоемꙋ̀ свидѣ́тельствꙋяй Сн҃ꙋ, ве́сь бы́въ соше́дшагѡ Дх҃а, возопѝ: ты̀ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇то́съ Бж҃їя мꙋ́дрость и҆ си́ла.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* I have heard, O Lord, Thy voice which Thou didst speak, the voice of one crying in the wilderness, when Thou didst thunder over many waters, bearing witness unto Thy Son; being filled with the Spirit Who descended, he cried aloud: Thou art Christ, the wisdom and the power of God.[^950]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
I have heard, O Lord, Thy voice which Thou didst speak, the voice of one crying in the wilderness, when Thou didst thunder over many waters, bearing witness unto Thy Son; being filled with the Spirit Who descended, he cried aloud: Thou art Christ, the wisdom and the power of God.[^950]

items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆чища́емо со́лнце кто̀ ви́дѣ, проповѣ́дникъ вопїе́тъ, пресвѣ́тлое є҆стество́мъ: да тебѐ вода́ми сїя́нїе сла́вы, О҆ц҃а̀ ѻ҆́бразъ присносꙋ́щнагѡ ѡ҆мы́ю: и҆ сѣ́но сы́й ѻ҆гню̀ прикоснꙋ́ся твоегѡ̀ бж҃ества̀: ты̀ бо є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇то́съ, Бж҃їя мꙋ́дрость и҆ си́ла.
items.english_text: Who has seen the sun, which is most radiant by nature, being cleansed? the preacher cries aloud. Shall I wash Thee with waters, the Radiance of glory, the Image of the ever-existing Father? And shall I, who am grass, touch the fire of Thy Godhead? For Thou art Christ, the wisdom and the power of God.[^951]

items.slavonic_text: Дꙋше́вное соверша́я мꙋ́дрѣ, и҆ сло́вомъ почте́ный, бездꙋ́шныхъ стыждꙋ́ся; а҆́ще бо крещꙋ́ тѧ клеве́тна мѝ є҆́сть ѻ҆гне́мъ дыма́щаяся гора̀: побѣ́гшее мо́ре же на дво́е, и҆ І҆орда́нъ се́й возврати́выйся: ты́ бо є҆сѝ Хрїсто́съ, Бж҃їя мꙋ́дрость и҆ си́ла.
items.english_text: Accomplishing what is of the soul wisely, and honored with reason, I am put to shame by things inanimate; for if I baptize Thee, the mountain smoking with fire will accuse me, as will the sea divided in two, and this Jordan which turned back: for Thou art Christ, the wisdom and the power of God.[^954]

provenance.verbatim_source: Accomplishing what is of the soul wisely, and honored with reason, I am put to shame by things inanimate; for if I baptize Thee, the mountain smoking with fire will accuse me, as will the sea divided in two, and this Jordan which turned back: for Thou art Christ, the wisdom and the power of God.[^954]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: По́сланъ ѿ О҆ц҃а̀ всесвѣ́тлое Сло́во, но́щи ѿгна́ти ѕломра́чное стремле́нїе, и҆ и҆скорени́ти грѧде́ши чл҃вѣ́кѡвъ грѣхѝ: сы́ны же привлещѝ твои́мъ кр҃ще́нїемъ бла́же свѣ́тлы ѿ стрꙋ́й І҆орда́нскихъ.
items.english_text: Cleansed by the fire of mystical contemplation, the prophet, singing the renewal of mankind, utters a voice inspired by the Spirit, declaring the incarnation of the ineffable Word, by Whom the dominions of the mighty have been shattered.[^955]

provenance.verbatim_source: Cleansed by the fire of mystical contemplation, the prophet, singing the renewal of mankind, utters a voice inspired by the Spirit, declaring the incarnation of the ineffable Word, by Whom the dominions of the mighty have been shattered.[^955]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Са́мое прови́дѣвъ нарече́нное сло́во, я́снѡ проповѣ́дникъ вопїе́тъ тва́ри: се́й пре́жде менѐ, вторы́й пло́тїю, сообразенъ простїя̀ боже́ственною си́лою, враже́бный на́шъ ѿѧ́ти грѣ́хъ.
items.english_text: Sent forth from the Father, O all-radiant Word, Thou comest to drive away the dark and evil surge of night, and to uproot the sins of men; and by Thy baptism, O Good One, to draw forth radiant sons from the streams of the Jordan.[^956]

provenance.verbatim_source: Sent forth from the Father, O all-radiant Word, Thou comest to drive away the dark and evil surge of night, and to uproot the sins of men; and by Thy baptism, O Good One, to draw forth radiant sons from the streams of the Jordan.[^956]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Па́жить оу҆ себѐ животво́рнꙋ нося̀, оу҆ловля́етъ ѕмїе́въ гнѣзда́мъ натека́я мно́гими сѣтьмѝ, низлага́я Бг҃ъ сло́во: запина́етъ * оу҆язвѝвшаго всемї́рный ро́дъ, сегѡ̀ потре́бль и҆збавля́етъ тва́рь.
items.english_text: Foreseeing the very Word foretold, the preacher cries aloud clearly unto creation: This One, Who is after me, second according to the flesh, is made like unto us, shining forth with divine power to take away our hostile sin.[^957]

provenance.verbatim_source: Foreseeing the very Word foretold, the preacher cries aloud clearly unto creation: This One, Who is after me, second according to the flesh, is made like unto us, shining forth with divine power to take away our hostile sin.[^957]

items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Па́жить оу҆ себѐ животво́рнꙋ нося̀, оу҆ловля́етъ ѕмїе́въ гнѣзда́мъ натека́я мно́гими сѣтьмѝ, низлага́я Бг҃ъ сло́во: запина́етъ * оу҆язвѝвшаго всемї́рный ро́дъ, сегѡ̀ потре́бль и҆збавля́етъ тва́рь.
items.english_text: Bearing in Himself life-giving pasture, God the Word captures the nests of dragons, rushing upon them with many snares and casting them down; He trips up him who wounded the race of all the world, and having destroyed him, delivers creation.[^958]

provenance.verbatim_source: Bearing in Himself life-giving pasture, God the Word captures the nests of dragons, rushing upon them with many snares and casting them down; He trips up him who wounded the race of all the world, and having destroyed him, delivers creation.[^958]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь є҃. — І҆рмо́съ: І҆исъ живота̀ нача́лникъ, разрѣши́ти ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїе грѧде́тъ, А҆да́ма первозда́ннагѡ, ѡ҆чище́нїй же ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ не тре́бꙋя, па́дшаго ѡ҆чища́етъ во І҆орда́нѣ: въ не́мже враждꙋ̀ оу҆би́въ, преимꙋ́щъ вся́къ оу҆́мъ ми́ръ да́рꙋетъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Jesus, the Prince of life, comes to loose the condemnation of Adam the first-formed; and though as God He needs no cleansing, He cleanses fallen [man] in the Jordan, wherein having slain the enmity, He grants the peace that passes all understanding.[^959]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
Jesus, the Prince of life, comes to loose the condemnation of Adam the first-formed; and though as God He needs no cleansing, He cleanses fallen [man] in the Jordan, wherein having slain the enmity, He grants the peace that passes all understanding.[^959]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Сше́дшымъ безъ числа̀ лю́демъ ѿ І҆ѡа́нна крести́тися, са́мъ посредѣ̀ и҆́хъ ста̀; провозгласѝ же предстоя́щымъ: кто̀ показа̀ непокори́вїи гнѣ́ва ва́мъ оу҆клони́тися хотя́щагѡ бы́ти? плоды̀ досто́йны Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ сотвори́те, предстоя́й бо ны́нѣ ми́ръ да́рꙋетъ.
items.english_text: When countless people came together to be baptized by John, He Himself stood in their midst; and he proclaimed aloud unto those who were present: Who has shown you, O disobedient ones, to avoid the wrath to come? Bring forth fruits worthy for Christ; for He Who stands present now grants peace.[^960]

provenance.verbatim_source: When countless people came together to be baptized by John, He Himself stood in their midst; and he proclaimed aloud unto those who were present: Who has shown you, O disobedient ones, to avoid the wrath to come? Bring forth fruits worthy for Christ; for He Who stands present now grants peace.[^960]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Дѣ́латель и҆ зижди́тель посредѣ̀ стоя́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ всѣ́хъ, сердца̀ и҆спы́тꙋетъ, чисти́тельнꙋю же лопа́тꙋ рꙋко́ю прїе́мъ; всемї́рное гꙋмно̀ всемꙋ́дрѣ разлꙋча́етъ, непло́дїе паля̀, бл҃гопло́днымъ вѣ́чный живо́тъ да́рꙋетъ.
items.english_text: The Husbandman and Creator, standing in their midst as one of all, searches the hearts; and taking into His hand the winnowing fan, He all-wisely separates the threshing floor of the whole world, burning up the unfruitful, and granting eternal life unto the fruitful.[^961]

provenance.verbatim_source: The Husbandman and Creator, standing in their midst as one of all, searches the hearts; and taking into His hand the winnowing fan, He all-wisely separates the threshing floor of the whole world, burning up the unfruitful, and granting eternal life unto the fruitful.[^961]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Ви́дѣвъ зижди́тель, въ мра́цѣ прегрѣше́нїй плени́цами неизбѣ́жными, є҆го́же вообразѝ пе́рсты, поставля́етъ на ѻ҆́бою ра̑мꙋ воздви́гъ горѣ̀; ны́нѣ бо многотекꙋ́щихъ вода́хъ, ѡ҆мыва́я стꙋда̀ дре́внягѡ, А҆да́мова ѕла́гѡ нра́ва.
items.english_text: Washed clean by the purification of the Spirit from the dark and defiled poison of the enemy, we have attained unto a new, unerring path, leading unto unapproachable joy, accessible only unto those with whom God has been reconciled.[^962]

provenance.verbatim_source: Washed clean by the purification of the Spirit from the dark and defiled poison of the enemy, we have attained unto a new, unerring path, leading unto unapproachable joy, accessible only unto those with whom God has been reconciled.[^962]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Со бл҃гоче́стїемъ притеце́мъ прилѣ́жнѡ, ко и҆сто́чникомъ пречи́стымъ тече́нїя спаси́телнагѡ; сло́во оу҆смотрѧ́юще ѿ нетлѣ́нныѧ:
items.english_text: Seeing him whom He formed from the dust bound with inescapable cords in the gloom of transgressions, the Creator lifts him up and places him upon both shoulders; for now in the abundant flowing waters He washes away the ancient shame of Adam's wicked disposition.[^963]

provenance.verbatim_source: Seeing him whom He formed from the dust bound with inescapable cords in the gloom of transgressions, the Creator lifts him up and places him upon both shoulders; for now in the abundant flowing waters He washes away the ancient shame of Adam's wicked disposition.[^963]

items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Со бл҃гоче́стїемъ притеце́мъ прилѣ́жнѡ, ко и҆сто́чникомъ пречи́стымъ тече́нїя спаси́телнагѡ; сло́во оу҆смотрѧ́юще ѿ нетлѣ́нныѧ:
items.english_text: With piety let us eagerly run unto the most pure fountains of the saving stream, beholding the Word from an undefiled [Virgin]—[^964]

items.slavonic_text: почерпа́ла принося́ще жа́жды боже́ственныя: мі́ра сла́достнѣ исцѣля́я недꙋ́гъ.
items.english_text: —drawing vessels of divine thirst, sweetly healing the disease of the world.[^965]

provenance.verbatim_source: —drawing vessels of divine thirst, sweetly healing the disease of the world.[^965]

items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь ѕ҃. — І҆рмо́съ: Гла́съ словесѐ, свѣти́льникъ свѣ́та, денни́ца сл҃нца, Предте́ча, въ пꙋсты́ни пока́йтеся всѣ̑мъ вопіе́тъ лю́демъ, и҆ предочи́ститеся: се́ бо предстои́тъ Хрⷭ҇то́съ, ѿ тлѝ мі́ръ и҆збавля́яй.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* The voice of the Word, the lamp of the Light, the morning star of the Sun, the Forerunner, cries aloud in the wilderness unto all peoples: Repent, and purify yourselves beforehand; for behold, Christ is present, delivering the world from corruption.[^966]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Рожде́йся нетлѣ́ннѡ ѿ Бг҃а и҆ О҆ц҃а̀: ѿ Дв҃ы кромѣ̀ скве́рны воплоща́ется, Хрⷭ҇то́съ: є҆мꙋ́же реме́нь, ꙗ҆́же ѿ на́съ сло́ва сочета́нїѧ, разрѣши́ти неꙋдо́бъ ᲂу҆чи́тъ Предте́ча: земноро́дныѧ ѿ ле́сти и҆збавля́ѧ.
items.english_text: Born incorruptibly from God and the Father, Christ is incarnate without defilement from the Virgin; the Forerunner teaches that it is hard to loose the strap—the union of the Word with us—delivering the earthborn from deceit.[^967]

provenance.verbatim_source: Born incorruptibly from God and the Father, Christ is incarnate without defilement from the Virgin; the Forerunner teaches that it is hard to loose the strap—the union of the Word with us—delivering the earthborn from deceit.[^967]

items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: О҆гне́мъ крести́тъ коне́чнымъ Хрⷭ҇то́съ проти́вныѧ, а҆ не Бг҃а мꙋ́дрствꙋющихъ є҆го̀, Дх҃омъ же ѡ҆бновля́етъ водо́ю блгⷣа́ти разꙋмли́выѧ божества̀ є҆гѡ̀, ѿ прегрѣше́нїй и҆збавля́ѧ.
items.english_text: With final fire Christ baptizes those who oppose and do not esteem Him as God; but by the Spirit He renews through water of grace those who acknowledge His Godhead, delivering [them] from transgressions.[^968]

provenance.verbatim_source: With final fire Christ baptizes those who oppose and do not esteem Him as God; but by the Spirit He renews through water of grace those who acknowledge His Godhead, delivering [them] from transgressions.[^968]

items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany

items.slavonic_text: О҆́тъ глꙋби́ннагѡ льва̀, тривече́рнїй стра́ннѣ проро́къ во внꙋ́тренныхъ валя́ѧсѧ: а҆́бїе произни́де, пакибытїѧ̀ спасе́нїе, ѿ ѕмі́ѧ человѣкоꙋбі́йцы, всѣ̑мъ пред̾ѧвлѧ́ѧ въ послѣ̑днѧѧ лѣ́та.
items.english_text: With a most blessed voice the Father made known the Beloved, Whom He brought forth from the womb; yea, He says: This consubstantial Son, being radiant with light, has shone forth from the human race; [He is] My living Word, and by providence a man.[^969]

items.english_text: From the belly of the deep monster, the prophet strangely tumbled within for three evenings; straightway he came forth, manifesting unto all in the last times the salvation of regeneration from the manslaying dragon.[^970]

items.slavonic_text: І҆́косъ: Галіле́и ꙗ҆зы́честѣй, завꙋлѡ́нстѣй странѣ̀, и҆ нефѳали́мстѣй землѝ, ꙗ҆́коже речѐ проро́къ: свѣ́тъ вели́къ возсіѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́съ ѡ҆мраче́ннымъ; свѣтла̀ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ зарѧ̀, и҆зъ Виѳлее́ма ѡ҆блиста́ющаѧ, па́че же и҆зъ Марі́и Гдⷭ҇ь, все́й вселе́ннѣй возсіѧва́етъ лꙋчѝ, со́лнце пра́вды; тѣ́мже и҆́же ѿ А҆да́ма назі́и прїиди́те всѝ ѡ҆блече́мсѧ въ него̀, да согрѣ́емсѧ: покрыва́етъ бо нагі́ѧ, и҆ просвѣща́етъ те́мныѧ: прише́лъ є҆сѝ и҆ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ свѣ́тъ непристꙋ́пный.
items.english_text: *Ikos:* Unto Galilee of the Gentiles, unto the country of Zebulun, and unto the land of Naphtali, as the prophet said: a great light, Christ, has shone forth unto those who were darkened; a radiant dawn has appeared, flashing forth from Bethlehem; yea rather, the Lord from Mary, the Sun of righteousness, shines rays upon the whole universe; therefore, all you who are naked from Adam, come, let us clothe ourselves in Him, that we may be warmed; for He covers the naked and enlightens those who are in darkness: Thou hast come and appeared, the unapproachable Light.[^974]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ikos:*
Unto Galilee of the Gentiles, unto the country of Zebulun, and unto the land of Naphtali, as the prophet said: a great light, Christ, has shone forth unto those who were darkened; a radiant dawn has appeared, flashing forth from Bethlehem; yea rather, the Lord from Mary, the Sun of righteousness, shines rays upon the whole universe; therefore, all you who are naked from Adam, come, let us clothe ourselves in Him, that we may be warmed; for He covers the naked and enlightens those who are in darkness: Thou hast come and appeared, the unapproachable Light.[^974]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь з҃. — І҆рмо́съ: Ю҆́ноши бл҃гочести́выѧ пе́щи ѻ҆́гненнѣй приѡбщи́вшыѧсѧ, шꙋма́щъ дꙋ́хъ ро́сный невре́димы сохранѝ, и҆ Бж҃їа а҆́гг҃ла снизхожде́нїе: тѣ́мже въ пла́мени ѡ҆роша́еми бл҃года́рственнѡ воспѣва́хꙋ: препѣ́тый ѻ҆тце́въ Гдⷭ҇и и҆ Бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* When the godly youths were committed unto the fiery furnace, a rustling dewy wind preserved them unharmed, as did the descent of the angel of God; therefore, bedewed in the midst of the flame, they sang in thanksgiving: Blessed art Thou, O exceedingly praised Lord and God of our fathers.[^975]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
When the godly youths were committed unto the fiery furnace, a rustling dewy wind preserved them unharmed, as did the descent of the angel of God; therefore, bedewed in the midst of the flame, they sang in thanksgiving: Blessed art Thou, O exceedingly praised Lord and God of our fathers.[^975]

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже на небесѝ съ трепе́томъ и҆ чꙋ́домъ предстоя́хꙋ, во І҆орда́нѣ си́лы а҆́гг҃лскїѧ, смотрѧ́юще толи́ка Бж҃їѧ схожде́нїа: ꙗ҆́кѡ держа́й превы́шнихъ водъ соста́въ, въ вода́хъ плотоно́сецъ стоѧ́ше, Бг҃ъ ѻ҆тце́въ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: Even as in heaven, the angelic hosts stood in the Jordan with trembling and wonder, beholding so great a condescension of God: how He Who holds the firmament of the waters above stood clothed in flesh in the waters, the God of our fathers.[^976]

provenance.verbatim_source: Even as in heaven, the angelic hosts stood in the Jordan with trembling and wonder, beholding so great a condescension of God: how He Who holds the firmament of the waters above stood clothed in flesh in the waters, the God of our fathers.[^976]

items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany

items.slavonic_text: О҆́блакъ дре́вле и҆ мо́ре, бж҃е́ственнагѡ проѡбража́хꙋ кр҃ще́нїѧ чꙋ́до: въ ни́хже дре́внїи кр҃ти́шасѧ и҆сходя́ще зако́ннїи лю́дїе; мо́ре же
items.english_text: Of old the cloud and the sea prefigured the wonder of divine baptism, wherein the ancient people of the Law were baptized when departing; and the sea—[^977]

provenance.verbatim_source: Of old the cloud and the sea prefigured the wonder of divine baptism, wherein the ancient people of the Law were baptized when departing; and the sea—[^977]

items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: бѣ̀ ѡ҆́бразъ воды̀, и҆ ѡ҆́блакъ Дх҃а; и҆́миже соверша́еми, бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ зове́мъ: Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е во вѣ́кы.
items.english_text: —was an image of the water, and the cloud of the Spirit; being perfected by them, we cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto ages.[^978]

provenance.verbatim_source: —was an image of the water, and the cloud of the Spirit; being perfected by them, we cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto ages.[^978]

items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Всѝ вѣ́рнїи, въ не́мже соверше́нїе прїѧ́хомъ, бл҃госло́вѧще немо́лчнѡ со а҆́гг҃лы, просла́вимъ О҆ц҃а̀, и҆ Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а ст҃а́го; се́ бо Трⷪ҇ца ѵ҆поста́сми є҆диносꙋ́щнаѧ, є҆ди́нъ же Бг҃ъ; є҆мꙋ́же пое́мъ: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ Го́споди Бж҃е во вѣ́кы.
items.english_text: All we the faithful, in Whom we have received perfection, unceasingly blessing Him with the angels, let us glorify the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit; for behold, the Trinity is consubstantial in hypostases, yet one God; unto Whom we sing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto ages.[^979]

provenance.verbatim_source: All we the faithful, in Whom we have received perfection, unceasingly blessing Him with the angels, let us glorify the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit; for behold, the Trinity is consubstantial in hypostases, yet one God; unto Whom we sing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto ages.[^979]

items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ живописꙋ́ющій а҆ссѵрі́йскій пла́мень, ᲂу҆жа́сенъ поставля́еши, въ ро́сꙋ преведе́нъ: тѣ́мже вода̀ ны́нѣ: ꙗ҆́коже пла́мень ѻ҆дѣва́й вре́дную ѕло́бꙋ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, покровенныю ѡ҆паля́етъ, ѿ поползнове́нныѧ стєзѝ призыва́ющи.
items.english_text: He Who with a stream burned the heads of the dragons, and extinguished the high flame of the furnace holding the godly youths, has stilled the uncontrollable gloom born of sin, and washes away all things by the dew of the Spirit.[^980]

provenance.verbatim_source: He Who with a stream burned the heads of the dragons, and extinguished the high flame of the furnace holding the godly youths, has stilled the uncontrollable gloom born of sin, and washes away all things by the dew of the Spirit.[^980]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Раздѣли́вшꙋсѧ І҆орда́нꙋ дре́вле, по сꙋ́хꙋ прехо́дятъ лю́дїе І҆и҃лстїи, тебѐ держа́внѣйшаго содержа́ща тва́рь некосни́тельнѣ; ны́нѣ въ вода́хъ написꙋ́ющїи, къ нетлѣ́ннѣй и҆ поле́знѣй стезѝ.
items.english_text: Portraying Thee in image, Thou dost render terrible the Assyrian flame turned into dew; therefore, the water now, even as the flame, O Christ, burns the hidden harmful malice that clothes [the enemy], calling [us] back from the slippery path.[^981]

provenance.verbatim_source: Portraying Thee in image, Thou dost render terrible the Assyrian flame turned into dew; therefore, the water now, even as the flame, O Christ, burns the hidden harmful malice that clothes [the enemy], calling [us] back from the slippery path.[^981]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Вѣ́мы пе́рвїе всепа́гꙋбный пото́пъ, ми́лостивнѡ тѧ̀ всѣ́хъ во тлю̀ привестѝ; Ѽ тревели́каѧ сотворѧ́ѧ, и҆ стра́ннаѧ; ны́нѣ же пото́пльша Хрⷭ҇тѐ грѣ́хъ за бл҃госе́рдїе, и҆ чл҃вѣ́ческое спасе́нїе!
items.english_text: When the Jordan was divided of old, the people of Israel passed through on dry ground, depicting Thee, the most mighty One Who upholds creation without delay, now in the waters, [leading] unto an incorruptible and salutary path.[^982]

provenance.verbatim_source: When the Jordan was divided of old, the people of Israel passed through on dry ground, depicting Thee, the most mighty One Who upholds creation without delay, now in the waters, [leading] unto an incorruptible and salutary path.[^982]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь и҃. — І҆рмо́съ: Та́йнꙋ пресла́внꙋю вавѷлѡ́нскаѧ показа̀ пе́щь, и҆сточи́вшаѧ ро́сꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ стрꙋѧ́ми и҆ма́-
items.english_text: We know of the all-destroying deluge of old, whereby Thou didst mercifully bring all things into corruption, O Thou Who workest most great and marvelous deeds; but now, O Christ, Thou hast drowned sin through Thy tender compassion and for human salvation![^983]

provenance.verbatim_source: We know of the all-destroying deluge of old, whereby Thou didst mercifully bring all things into corruption, O Thou Who workest most great and marvelous deeds; but now, O Christ, Thou hast drowned sin through Thy tender compassion and for human salvation![^983]

items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The Babylonian furnace showed forth a most glorious mystery, pouring forth dew, because the Jordan was to receive with its streams—[^984]

items.slavonic_text: ше невеще́ственный ѻ҆́гнь воспріѧ́ти І҆орда́нъ ѡ҆б̾ѧ́ти пло́тїю кр҃ща́ема зижди́телѧ: є҆го́же бл҃госло́вѧтъ лю́дїе, и҆ превозно́сѧтъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́кы.
items.english_text: —the immaterial fire, and embrace the Creator being baptized in the flesh; Whom the peoples bless and highly exalt unto all ages.[^985]

provenance.verbatim_source: —the immaterial fire, and embrace the Creator being baptized in the flesh; Whom the peoples bless and highly exalt unto all ages.[^985]

items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Ѿложѝ стра́хъ ве́сь, и҆зба́витель Предте́чи речѐ, мнѣ́ же повинꙋ́йсѧ, ꙗ҆́ко бл҃го́мꙋ, мнѣ̀ престꙋпѝ, сіе́ бо є҆стество́мъ бы́хъ; мои̑мъ повелѣ́нїемъ покори́сѧ, и҆ крⷭ҇ти́ мѧ соше́дшаго: є҆го́же бл҃госло́вѧтъ лю́дїе, и҆ превозно́сѧтъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́кы.
items.english_text: Lay aside all fear, the Deliverer said unto the Forerunner, and submit unto Me as good, approach Me, for by nature I have become this; obey My command, and baptize Me Who have descended; Whom the peoples bless and highly exalt unto all ages.[^986]

provenance.verbatim_source: Lay aside all fear, the Deliverer said unto the Forerunner, and submit unto Me as good, approach Me, for by nature I have become this; obey My command, and baptize Me Who have descended; Whom the peoples bless and highly exalt unto all ages.[^986]

items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Гл҃го́лы ꙗ҆́коже ᲂу҆слы́ша кр҃ти́тель Влⷣчни, съ трепе́томъ дла́нь простира́етъ: ѻ҆ба́че же рꙋко́ю коснꙋ́всѧ верхꙋ̀ зижди́телѧ своегѡ̀, кре́щшемꙋсѧ вопіѧ́ше: ѡ҆ст҃и́ мѧ, ты́ бо є҆сѝ Бг҃ъ мо́й є҆го́же бл҃госло́вѧтъ лю́дїе, и҆ превозно́сѧтъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́кы.
items.english_text: When the Baptist heard the Master's words, he stretched forth his palm with trembling; yet touching with his hand the head of his Creator, he cried aloud unto Him Who was being baptized: Sanctify me, for Thou art my God, Whom the peoples bless and highly exalt unto all ages.[^987]

provenance.verbatim_source: When the Baptist heard the Master's words, he stretched forth his palm with trembling; yet touching with his hand the head of his Creator, he cried aloud unto Him Who was being baptized: Sanctify me, for Thou art my God, Whom the peoples bless and highly exalt unto all ages.[^987]

items.slavonic_text: Трⷪ҇цы ꙗ҆вле́нїе во І҆орда́нѣ бы́сть, са́мое бо пребж҃е́ственное є҆стество̀, О҆ц҃ъ возгласѝ: се́й креща́емый, Сы́нъ возлю́бленный мо́й: Дх҃ъ же прїи́де къ подо́бномꙋ, є҆го́же бл҃госло́вѧтъ лю́дїе, и҆ превозно́сѧтъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́кы.
items.english_text: A manifestation of the Trinity took place in the Jordan; for the supreme divine Nature Itself, the Father, proclaimed: This One Who is baptized is My beloved Son; and the Spirit came upon His peer; Whom the peoples bless and highly exalt unto all ages.[^988]

provenance.verbatim_source: A manifestation of the Trinity took place in the Jordan; for the supreme divine Nature Itself, the Father, proclaimed: This One Who is baptized is My beloved Son; and the Spirit came upon His peer; Whom the peoples bless and highly exalt unto all ages.[^988]

items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Трі́е бг҃ови́днїи во ѻ҆гнѝ ѡ҆роша́еми, ѡ҆зарѧ́ющесѧ, тремѝ всесвѣ́тлѣ ст҃и́нами: ꙗ҆́вѣ пока́зовахꙋ, превы́шнее є҆стество̀ смѣше́нїемъ человѣ́ческимъ, ѻ҆гнепаля́щее росо́ю ми́лостивнѡ, всѧ́кꙋ па́гꙋбнꙋю ле́сть.
items.english_text: Creation is recognized as set free, and those previously darkened are [now] sons of light; the ruler of darkness alone groans; now let the inheritance of the Gentiles, formerly wretched, fervently bless the Cause.[^989]

provenance.verbatim_source: Creation is recognized as set free, and those previously darkened are [now] sons of light; the ruler of darkness alone groans; now let the inheritance of the Gentiles, formerly wretched, fervently bless the Cause.[^989]

items.slavonic_text: Трі́е бг҃ови́днїи во ѻ҆гнѝ ѡ҆роша́еми, ѡ҆зарѧ́ющесѧ, тремѝ всесвѣ́тлѣ ст҃и́нами: ꙗ҆́вѣ пока́зовахꙋ, превы́шнее є҆стество̀ смѣше́нїемъ человѣ́ческимъ, ѻ҆гнепаля́щее росо́ю ми́лостивнѡ, всѧ́кꙋ па́гꙋбнꙋю ле́сть.
items.english_text: The three godlike youths, bedewed in the fire and illuminated with three all-radiant sanctities, clearly showed forth the transcendent Nature in human communion, mercifully burning up all destructive deceit by dew.[^990]

provenance.verbatim_source: The three godlike youths, bedewed in the fire and illuminated with three all-radiant sanctities, clearly showed forth the transcendent Nature in human communion, mercifully burning up all destructive deceit by dew.[^990]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Да ᲂу҆бѣли́тсѧ всѧ́кое земно́е є҆стество̀, ѿ паде́нїѧ ны́нѣ на не́бо возводи́мо, и҆́мже бо всѧ̑ соблюда́ютсѧ сло́вомъ, текꙋ́щими стрꙋѧ́ми ѡ҆мы́вшисѧ, прегрѣше́нїй пре́жнихъ, ᲂу҆бѣжѐ, пресвѣ́тлѡ и҆змове́но.
items.english_text: Let all earthly nature be whitened, now being led up unto heaven from the fall; for having been washed in the flowing streams by the Word by Whom all things are preserved, it has escaped former transgressions, washed most radiantly.[^991]

provenance.verbatim_source: Let all earthly nature be whitened, now being led up unto heaven from the fall; for having been washed in the flowing streams by the Word by Whom all things are preserved, it has escaped former transgressions, washed most radiantly.[^991]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ І҆рмо́съ: Недоꙋмѣ́етъ всѧ́къ ꙗ҆зы́къ бл҃гохвали́ти по достоѧ́нїю, и҆зꙋмѣва́етъ же ᲂу҆́мъ и҆ всемíрный пѣ́ти тѧ̀ Бцⷣе, ѻ҆ба́че блага́ѧ сꙋ́щи, вѣ́рꙋ прїимѝ, и҆́бо любо́вь вѣ́си боже́ственнꙋю на́шꙋ: ты́ бо хрїстїа́нъ є҆сѝ предста́тельница, тѧ̀ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: Magnify, O my soul, the most pure Virgin Theotokos, more honorable than the heavenly hosts.[^992]

provenance.verbatim_source: Magnify, O my soul, the most pure Virgin Theotokos, more honorable than the heavenly hosts.[^992]

items.office: Matins on Holy Theophany
items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Дави́де прїидѝ дх҃омъ къ просвѣще́ннымъ: ны́нѣ пристꙋпи́те, по́й къ Бг҃ꙋ вѣ́рою, глаго́лѧ: просвѣти́теся, се́й ни́щій воззва̀ А҆да́мъ въ паде́нїи: и҆́бо того̀ ᲂу҆слы́ша Гдⷭ҇ь, прише́дъ стрꙋѧ́ми І҆орда́нскими, тлѣ́ннаго же ѡ҆бновѝ.
items.english_text: Every tongue is at a loss to praise [Thee] worthily, and even an intellect beyond this world is dazed in singing [praise] unto Thee, O Theotokos; yet, being good, accept our faith, for Thou knowest our divine love; for Thou art the protectress of Christians: Thee do we magnify.[^993]

provenance.verbatim_source: Every tongue is at a loss to praise [Thee] worthily, and even an intellect beyond this world is dazed in singing [praise] unto Thee, O Theotokos; yet, being good, accept our faith, for Thou knowest our divine love; for Thou art the protectress of Christians: Thee do we magnify.[^993]

items.english_text: Magnify, O my soul, Him Who seeks baptism from the Forerunner.[^994]

items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: И҆са́їа, и҆змы́йтеся, ѡ҆чи́ститеся, глаго́летъ, лꙋка́вствїа пре́дъ Гдⷭ҇емъ ѡ҆ста́вите: жа́ждꙋщїи на во́дꙋ жи́вꙋ и҆ди́те: кропи́тъ бо водо́ю ѡ҆бновля́ѧ Хрⷭ҇то́съ, пристꙋпа́ющыѧ къ немꙋ̀ вѣ́рою: и҆ къ животꙋ̀ неста́рѣемомꙋ, кр҃ща́етъ Дх҃омъ.
items.english_text: Isaiah says: Wash yourselves, make yourselves clean, put away your evil doings before the Lord; you who thirst, go unto living water; for Christ sprinkles with water, renewing those who draw near unto Him with faith, and baptizes with the Spirit unto unaging life.[^999]

provenance.verbatim_source: Isaiah says: Wash yourselves, make yourselves clean, put away your evil doings before the Lord; you who thirst, go unto living water; for Christ sprinkles with water, renewing those who draw near unto Him with faith, and baptizes with the Spirit unto unaging life.[^999]

items.slavonic_text: Прⷪ҇ро́че прїидѝ ко мнѣ̀, прострѝ рꙋ́кꙋ и҆ крести́ мѧ ско́рѡ. Прⷪ҇ро́че ѡ҆ста́ви ны́нѣ и҆ кр҃ти́ мѧ хотя́ща, и҆спо́лнити бо прїидо́хъ всѧ́кꙋ пра́вдꙋ.
items.english_text: *Refrain:* O prophet, come unto Me, stretch forth thy hand and baptize Me quickly.[^1000]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Refrain:* O prophet, come unto Me, stretch forth thy hand and baptize Me quickly.[^1000]

items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Соблюда́емсѧ бл҃года́тїю вѣ́рнїи, и҆ печа́тїю: ꙗ҆́кѡ бо гꙋби́телѧ бѣжа́ша, пра́га є҆вре́и дре́вле ѡ҆крова́влена: та́кѡ и҆ на́мъ и҆схо́дное боже́ственное сіѐ, пакибытїѧ̀ ба́нѧ бꙋ́детъ; ѿсю́дꙋ и҆ Трⷪ҇цы ᲂу҆́зримъ свѣ́тъ незаходи́мый.
items.english_text: *Refrain:* O prophet, permit it now and baptize Me who desire it; for I have come to fulfill all righteousness.[^1001]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Refrain:* O prophet, permit it now and baptize Me who desire it; for I have come to fulfill all righteousness.[^1001]

items.season_or_tone: Great Compline on Holy Theophany
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ д҃. Подо́б.: Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ...
items.slavonic_text: Посе́мъ пе́рвый ли́къ пое́тъ в҃-гѡ канѡ́на Припѣ́въ: Дне́сь Влⷣка преклоня́етъ вы́ю по́дъ рꙋ́кꙋ Предте́чевꙋ.
items.english_text: We the faithful are preserved by grace and by the seal; for as of old the Hebrews escaped the destroyer through the blood-marked lintel, so also this divine bath of regeneration shall be an exodus for us; and hence we shall behold the unwaning light of the Trinity.[^1002]

provenance.verbatim_source: We the faithful are preserved by grace and by the seal; for as of old the Hebrews escaped the destroyer through the blood-marked lintel, so also this divine bath of regeneration shall be an exodus for us; and hence we shall behold the unwaning light of the Trinity.[^1002]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ вторы́й ли́къ та́кожде пое́тъ Припѣ́въ и҆ І҆рмо́съ: И҆ про́чыѧ пѧ́ть Припѣ́вы: є҆ди́нъ к-жды. Дне́сь І҆ѡа́ннъ кр҃ща́етъ Влⷣкꙋ во стрꙋѧ́хъ І҆орда́нскихъ. Дне́сь Влⷣка, вода́ми погреба́етъ чл҃вѣ́ческій грѣ́хъ.
items.english_text: Today the Master bows His neck beneath the hand of the Forerunner.[^1003]

provenance.verbatim_source: Today the Master bows His neck beneath the hand of the Forerunner.[^1003]

items.english_text: *Heirmos:* O the marvels beyond comprehension of thy childbearing, all-pure Bride, blessed Mother! Having obtained all-perfect salvation through her, we worthily praise [Thee] as our Benefactor, bringing as a gift a song of thanksgiving.[^1004]

items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Ты́ во І҆орда́нѣ кре́щсѧ Сп҃се на́шъ
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинный свѣ́тъ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ, и҆ всѣ̑мъ просвѣще́нїе да́рꙋетъ; креща́етсѧ Хрⷭ҇то́съ съ на́ми, и҆́же всѧ́кїѧ вы́шши чистоты̀; влага́етъ ст҃е́нїе водѣ̀, и҆ дꙋша́мъ сіѐ ѡ҆чище́нїе быва́етъ: земно́е ꙗ҆вля́емое, и҆ вы́ше небе́съ разꙋмѣва́емое; ба́нею спасе́нїе, водо́ю же Дх҃ъ: погруже́нїа ра́ди и҆́же къ Бг҃ꙋ на́шъ восхо́дъ быва́етъ; чꙋде́сна дѣла̀ твоѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: The true Light has appeared, and grants enlightenment unto all; Christ, Who is higher than all purity, is baptized with us; He imparts sanctification unto the water, and it becomes a cleansing for souls; what is seen is earthly, and what is understood is higher than the heavens; salvation is through the bath, and through the water is the Spirit; by immersion our ascent unto God is accomplished: marvelous are Thy works, O Lord, glory to Thee.[^1019]

provenance.verbatim_source: The true Light has appeared, and grants enlightenment unto all; Christ, Who is higher than all purity, is baptized with us; He imparts sanctification unto the water, and it becomes a cleansing for souls; what is seen is earthly, and what is understood is higher than the heavens; salvation is through the bath, and through the water is the Spirit; by immersion our ascent unto God is accomplished: marvelous are Thy works, O Lord, glory to Thee.[^1019]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ в҃. Дне́сь Хрⷭ҇то́съ на І҆орда́нъ прїи́де кр҃ти́тисѧ; дне́сь І҆ѡа́ннъ каса́етсѧ верхꙋ̀ Влⷣчню; си́лы нбⷭ҇ныѧ ᲂу҆жасо́шасѧ: пресла́вное ви́дѧще та́инство; мо́ре ви́дѣ, и҆ побѣжѐ, І҆орда́нъ ви́дѣвъ, возврати́сѧ; мы́ же просвѣ́щшеся вопіе́мъ: сла́ва ꙗ҆ви́вшемꙋсѧ Бг҃ꙋ, и҆ на землѝ ви́дѣнномꙋ, и҆ просвѣти́вшемꙋ мі́ръ.
items.english_text: Thou hast clothed Thyself with the waters of the Jordan, O Savior, Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment; and Thou hast bowed Thy head unto the Forerunner, Thou Who didst measure the heaven with a span; that Thou mightest turn the world away from deceit and save it, as Lover of mankind.[^1020]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast clothed Thyself with the waters of the Jordan, O Savior, Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment; and Thou hast bowed Thy head unto the Forerunner, Thou Who didst measure the heaven with a span; that Thou mightest turn the world away from deceit and save it, as Lover of mankind.[^1020]

items.slavonic_text: Славосло́вїе вели́кое: Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ Бг҃ꙋ: (зрѝ стр. 119); По Трисвѧто́мъ Тропа́рь Бг҃оѧвле́нїа: Во І҆орда́нѣ кр҃ща́ющꙋсѧ... (зрѝ стр. 260); Є҆кте́нїа; И҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ.
items.english_text: Today Christ comes unto the Jordan to be baptized; today John touches the head of the Master; the heavenly powers were struck with awe, beholding the most glorious mystery; the sea saw and fled, Jordan seeing it was turned back; and we who are enlightened cry aloud: Glory to God Who has appeared, and was seen on earth, and has enlightened the world.[^1021]

provenance.verbatim_source: Today Christ comes unto the Jordan to be baptized; today John touches the head of the Master; the heavenly powers were struck with awe, beholding the most glorious mystery; the sea saw and fled, Jordan seeing it was turned back; and we who are enlightened cry aloud: Glory to God Who has appeared, and was seen on earth, and has enlightened the world.[^1021]

items.slavonic_text: А҆нтїфѡ́нъ а҃. Стíхъ: Во и҆схо́дѣ І҆и҃левѣ ѿ Є҆гѵ́пта, до́мꙋ І҆а́кѡвлѧ, и҆зъ люде́й ва́рваръ. Припѣ́въ: Мл҃твами Бцⷣы, Сп҃се спасѝ на́съ. Стíхъ: Бы́сть І҆ꙋде́а свѧты́нѧ є҆гѡ̀, І҆и҃ль ѻ҆́бласть є҆гѡ̀. Мл҃твами Бцⷣы, Сп҃се спасѝ на́съ. Стíхъ: Мо́ре ви́дѣ и҆ побѣжѐ, І҆орда́нъ возврати́сѧ вспѧ́ть. Мл҃твами Бцⷣы, Сп҃се спасѝ на́съ. Стíхъ: Что́ ти є҆́сть мо́ре, ꙗ҆́кѡ побѣ́гло є҆сѝ? и҆ тебѣ̀ І҆орда́не, ꙗ҆́ко возврати́лсѧ є҆сѝ вспѧ́ть. Мл҃твами Бцⷣы, Сп҃се спасѝ на́съ. Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Мл҃твами Бцⷣы, Сп҃се спасѝ на́съ.

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆ви́хсѧ ве́сь человѣ́къ ны́нѣ,* пристꙋ́пенъ тебѣ̀ бы́хъ,* є҆стество́мъ непристꙋ́пный:* во́лею ѡ҆бнища́хъ бога́тъ сы́й,* ꙗ҆́кѡ да ѡ҆бниша́вшее ѡ҆богащꙋ̀* нетлѣ́нїемъ и҆ и҆збавле́нїемъ;* пристꙋпѝ крестѝ,* тлѣ́нїю неподлежа́щаго,* и҆ мі́ръ ѿ тлѝ и҆зима́ющаго.
items.english_text: I have appeared as whole man now, and have become accessible unto thee, though inaccessible by nature; willingly I have become poor, being rich, that I may enrich what has grown poor with incorruption and deliverance; approach and baptize [Me], Who am not subject to corruption, and Who take away the world from corruption.[^1060]

items.slavonic_text: Содержи́мъ є҆́смь ѿвсю́дꙋ,* и҆ ка́кѡ бѣжа́ти недоꙋмѣ́юсѧ:* речѐ зижди́телю Предте́ча:* пото́къ сы́й пи́щный ще́дре,* ка́кѡ ꙋ҆́бѡ тѧ̀* рѣчны́ѧ вше́дшаго прїи́мꙋтъ стрꙋѝ,* и҆ злива́юща спасе́нїе,* почита́ющымъ твоѐ,* ст҃о́е Сло́ве ꙗ҆вле́нїе.
items.english_text: I am hemmed in on every side, and how to flee I know not, said the Forerunner unto the Creator: being the torrent of delight, O Bountiful One, how shall the river streams receive Thee Who hast entered, and Who pourest out salvation unto those who honor Thy holy manifestation, O Word?[^1061]

Ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣ тѧ̀ Влⷣко І҆ѡа́ннъ Предте́ча,* къ не́мꙋ и҆дꙋ́ща,* ꙋ҆жа́сенъ бы́въ,* ꙗ҆́кѡ благонра́венъ ра́бъ со стра́хомъ вопїѧ́ше:* ко́е смире́нїе Сп҃се?* ка́ѧ нищета̀ въ ню́же ѡ҆дѣ́ѧлсѧ є҆сѝ?* бога́тствомъ бл҃гости смири́вшагосѧ чл҃вѣ́ка возне́съ,* ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ,* ꙗ҆́кѡ въ него̀ ѡ҆дѣ́выйсѧ. Сті́хъ: Мо́ре ви́дѣ и҆ побѣжѐ, І҆орда́нъ возврати́сѧ вспѧ́ть. Грѧдѝ ко мнѣ̀,* та́инство соверша́ющемꙋ сп҃си́телное,* Предте́чи противовѣща́лъ є҆сѝ,* со стра́хомъ послꙋжѝ, Спа́се всѧ́ческихъ, и҆ не ꙋ҆жаса́йсѧ;* сокрꙋше́ннаго бо А҆да́ма грѣхо́мъ ѡ҆бновлѧ́ѧ,* кр҃ща́юсѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃вѣ́къ,* є҆стество́мъ нескве́рный,* І҆орда́нскими вода́ми,* въ ни́хже ви́диши прише́дша мѧ̀. Сті́хъ: Что̀ ти є҆́сть мо́ре, ꙗ҆́кѡ побѣ́гло є҆сѝ? И҆ тебѣ̀ І҆орда́не, ꙗ҆́кѡ возврати́лсѧ є҆сѝ. Сл҃нце ѡ҆чища́емо* кто̀ ѿ земноро́дныхъ ви́дѣ?* І҆ѡа́ннъ проти́вꙋ речѐ,* и҆ ѡ҆дѣва́ющаго не́бо ѻ҆́блакы ѡ҆бнажа́ема всегѡ̀,* и҆ и҆сто́чники и҆ рѣ́кы содѣва́ющаго въ во́ды входѧ́ща;* дивлю́сѧ несказа́нномꙋ смотре́нїю твоемꙋ̀ Влⷣко:* не ѡ҆тѧгчѝ раба̀ твоего̀* стра́шными повелѣ́нїи.
items.english_text: When John the Forerunner beheld Thee coming unto him, O Master, he was struck with dread, and as a well-disposed servant he cried aloud with fear: What is this condescension, O Savior? What is this poverty wherewith Thou hast clothed Thyself? By the wealth of Thy goodness Thou hast exalted man who had humbled himself, as Thou art compassionate, since Thou hast clothed Thyself in him.[^1069]

By the wealth of Thy goodness Thou hast exalted man who had humbled himself, as Thou art compassionate, since Thou hast clothed Thyself in him.[^1069]

items.english_text: Thou didst answer the Forerunner, O Savior of all: Come unto Me Who am accomplishing a saving mystery; serve with fear and be not terrified; for renewing Adam who was crushed by sin, I am baptized as man, being undefiled by nature, in the waters of the Jordan, into which thou seest Me come.[^1071]

John said in return; and [who has seen] Him Who clothes the heaven with clouds stripped entirely, and the Maker of fountains and rivers stepping into the waters? I marvel at Thine ineffable dispensation, O Master: burden not Thy servant with fearful commands.[^1073]

items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 2:* The memory of the righteous is celebrated with hymns of praise, but the testimony of the Lord is sufficient for thee, O Forerunner; for thou wast shown forth in truth as the most honorable of the prophets, since thou wast accounted worthy to baptize in the streams Him Whom thou didst proclaim; therefore, having suffered for the truth with rejoicing, thou didst announce good tidings even unto those in Hades of God Who appeared in the flesh, Who takes away the sin of the world, and grants us great mercy.[^1076]

provenance.verbatim_source:

The memory of the righteous is celebrated with hymns of praise, but the testimony of the Lord is sufficient for thee, O Forerunner; for thou wast shown forth in truth as the most honorable of the prophets, since thou wast accounted worthy to baptize in the streams Him Whom thou didst proclaim; therefore, having suffered for the truth with rejoicing, thou didst announce good tidings even unto those in Hades of God Who appeared in the flesh, Who takes away the sin of the world, and grants us great mercy.[^1076]
